claim: `PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing.mk` forces callers to supply `map_id`/`map_comp` proofs even in cases where `by cat_disch` can discharge them automatically (mirroring how many `PresheafOfModules` constructions omit these fields). This makes the API unnecessarily verbose.
requested_change:
Give `map_id` and `map_comp` default values `:= by cat_disch` so callers can omit them when they are definitional/trivial. This compiles with e.g.
```lean
abbrev mk (obj : ∀ X, ModuleCat.{v} (R.obj X))
    (map : ∀ {X Y} (f : X ⟶ Y), obj X ⟶ (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (R.map f).hom).obj (obj Y))
    (map_id : ∀ X, _ := by cat_disch)
    (map_comp : ∀ {X Y Z} f g, _ := by cat_disch) :
    PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing.{v} R := { obj := obj, map := map, map_id := map_id, map_comp := map_comp }
```
